qasc.selection: within each correct position created by an answer-blind candidate-text permutation, take the first SHA-256(id, question, ordered source choices, fact1, fact2) rows after token admission
qasc.candidate_policy: keep all eight answer texts, hide source letters, order by SHA-256(question, candidate text), then assign opaque option-01..option-08 IDs
qasc.context_policy: include question, fact1 and fact2; exclude combinedfact because it often restates the answer
qasc.redistribution: raw and transformed QASC rows remain in ignored local directories; public bundles contain preparation code, checksums, attribution and aggregate evidence only

training.teacher_scope: the 512 replay rows only; QASC rows use upstream gold answers without teacher targets
training.weighting: every replay and QASC row has weight 1; QASC correct positions are exactly balanced after the answer-blind permutation

development_suite.role: Consumed development diagnostic only; permanently ineligible as a fresh test.

screening_rule.decision: Advance only if every condition passes. A later release study still requires newly sealed and previously unread task families.

interpretation.primary_question: Does low-rate eight-way natural science evidence training improve semantic candidate scoring and evidence use while functional distillation preserves the existing decision function?
interpretation.bigbench_training_excluded: BIG-bench task files carry an explicit benchmark canary asking that they not enter training corpora; no new BIG-bench row is used here.
interpretation.super_natural_instructions_training_defe: The aggregate repository is Apache-2.0 but individual upstream task licenses vary; no Super-NaturalInstructions row is used here.
